name: cerulean
description: Cerulean — plug-anywhere master orchestrator: Technitium DNS/DHCP/ad-blocking, Let's Encrypt wildcard (90-day PKI offline → ACME when online) via Technitium DNS-01, nginx proxy manager, Authentik SSO, vault, discovery and health scoring.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
